difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises relatively ample invertible sheaves for a morphism of finite type by the existence of an open covering of the base over which a positive tensor power of the sheaf is the pullback of the twisting sheaf along an immersion into a projective bundle. The proof establishes the forward implication by taking an affine open covering of the base and applying the affine criterion for ampleness and very ampleness to the restrictions, and the reverse implication directly from the relative ampleness criterion.
